name: Vijay Thakkar
review: I recently visited The Food Town in Mulund and had a delightful dining experience. The ambiance was stylish and inviting, with dim lighting that added to the cozy atmosphere. The service was prompt and friendly, with staff knowledgeable about the menu. The highlight of my meal was the Pink Pasta, which was incredibly flavorful and cooked to perfection. I also enjoyed the Fresh Lime Soda, which was refreshing and just right for the meal. The variety of dishes available is impressive, offering a range of vegetarian options across different cuisines. Overall, I highly recommend The Food Town for its excellent food and great service.

name: Keshav Dubey
review:
I visited Food town recently and I must say it's a good place for vegetarians. They have 2 floors for seating, the ambiance is good, service is prompt and fast and food tastes great.

Recommendation

1) Triple Schezwan fried rice - the rice was long and it tasked good on it own but paired with the gravy it tasted delicious

2) Asparagus Tempura Shushi - Those who like sushi will definitely like this as well, sofr rice with crunchy Tempura tasted amazing although their wasabi was not original tasted more like garlic.

3) Lasooni Masala - This was one of the best Lasooni Masala I have tried, paired with Tandoor Butter roti it tasted absolute delicious

4) Panner Chilly Bao - One of the best Bao I have tried so far, soft Bao with delicious Paneer filling it was incredible.

Overall the food tasted really good, some of the dishes were not up to the mark like cheese cigar rolls, Mexican Pizza.

Must visit if you are vegetarian and looking for fusion food and multi cuisine dishes.

name: Akansha Rawat
review:
This was a really nice restaurant with every option in veg. Like, where do I start... We planned on eating a proper non veg main course but ended up coming here without a proper survey... However the dishes we ordered were delicious. It makes me wanna go here again fr. Every dish was recommended by their employee. I would absolutely suggest you to go with their recommendations by letting them know ur choice of taste.
First we ordered starters :
Paneer Tikka - properly smoked and spices were added so well to the softness of paneer. The salad with it gives a perfect flavour to your mouth to eat together.
Cheese Cigar Roll - These were dipped in Schezwan sauce that already gave it a cheesy and additional spicy flavour. A different thing that I liked about this dish was, the crunch and flavour of the cover it had.
Chilli Paneer Bao - we usually do take chilli paneer starters, instead this was a contradictory flavour to the normal one as the Bao gave it a sweet bun flavour with those flavourful spices.
Then, I couldn't resist myself to try this Freak Shake. It was worth the money !! So sweet, yum, with ice cream, chocolate milkshake. It's really enough for one with a small appetite.
Asparagus Cheese Sushi - trust me this can be a mind changer for all Sushi haters lol, it was delicious. The crunchy topping and inside flavour was a balance to that whole sushi.

For the main course we ordered :
Large Mexican Sizzler - That sizzled vegetables never tasted so fresh. Even there was better crunch in the fries than we usually have. The patty was so stuffed and good that it was worth trying this out!

A must recommended visit to this resto guys. Ur next stop - TFT
